title: ADC12 最高采样率 DMA 搬运
description: This example demonstrates how to capture 1024 samples of a single ADC channel using 12-bit ADC resolution mode at maximum sampling rate. A DMA transfer is triggered every time a new result is loaded to ADC conversion memory and will continue the transfer until 1024 samples are loaded to gADCSamples（SDK 例程：adc12_max_freq_dma）
